The machinery and manpower shall be deployed strictly on an as-and-when-required basis, depending upo

n snowfall, weather conditions, field requirements and directions of the authorised officer of the Municipal Committee. The requirement of machinery and manpower shall be as under: S. No. Description Quantity 1. JCB Excavator/Backhoe Loader 02 Nos. 2. Tipper for lifting and transportation of snow 02 Nos. 3. Tractor fitted with Snow Blade/Leveller/Trailler 02 Nos. 4. Manpower for manual snow clearance and allied field 15 Persons operations The scope of work shall include clearance of snow from roads, lanes, by-lanes, footpaths, drains, approach es to essential public services and other identified public places, besides lifting and transportation of accu mulated snow wherever required. The manpower shall undertake manual snow clearance at locations inac cessible to machinery and other allied field operations as directed by the Municipal Committee. 1. Scope of Work Municipal Committee Khansahib invites online bids through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) for hirin g of machinery, namely JCBs, Tippers and Tractors, along with manpower for undertaking snow-clearance o perations within the municipal limits of Khansahib during Winter Season 2026-27, for the period commenci ng from 29.11.2026 to 31.03.2027. The machinery and manpower shall be deployed strictly on an as-and-when-required basis, depending upo n snowfall, weather conditions, field requirements and directions of the authorised officer of the Municipal Committee. 2. Terms and Conditions 1. The successful bidder/agency shall provide the required machinery and manpower strictly on an as-and -when-required basis, upon requisition by the Municipal Committee during the contract period. 2. The Municipal Committee shall have the discretion to requisition all or any of the machinery and manpo wer, depending upon the intensity of snowfall and actual field requirements. No minimum deployment, working hours, working days or payment shall be guaranteed to the successful bidder. 3. The successful bidder shall ensure the availability of all six machinery units, along with the required ope rators/drivers and up to 15 manpower personnel, whenever requisitioned by the authorised officer of th e Municipal Committee, including during night hours, holidays and emergency situations. 4. The agency shall ensure timely deployment of the required machinery and manpower at the designated locations within the time specified by the Municipal Committee after receipt of requisition/deployment i nstructions. 5. All machinery shall be in good working condition, roadworthy and suitable for snow-clearance operation s. JCBs shall be equipped with appropriate buckets, while tractors shall be fitted with suitable snow bla des/levellers for effective snow clearance. 6. The agency shall provide competent and experienced operators/drivers for operating the respective ma chinery. All expenses relating to their wages, remuneration and other employment-related liabilities sh all be borne by the successful bidder. 7. The rates quoted for machinery shall be inclusive of all expenses, including POL (petrol/diesel), lubricant s, operator/driver charges, maintenance, repairs, transportation, applicable taxes and other incidental expenses. No additional charges shall be payable by the Municipal Committee on any account. 8. The agency shall be responsible for regular maintenance and upkeep of the machinery. In case of any br eakdown or mechanical failure, the agency shall immediately arrange for repair or replacement of the machinery without any additional financial liability to the Municipal Committee. 9. The agency shall ensure that the machinery remains operational throughout the contract period and sh all not withdraw any machinery without prior permission of the authorized officer of the Municipal Com mittee. 10. The agency shall provide up to 15 manpower personnel for manual snow clearance and allied field ope

rations, as and when required by the Municipal Committee. The manpower shall be deployed at the loc ations and in the numbers specified by the authorized officer. 11. The manpower shall undertake manual removal of snow from lanes, by-lanes, footpaths, drains, appro aches to public institutions and other locations inaccessible to machinery or identified by the Municipal Committee. 12. The manpower shall be engaged and paid at the Government-approved rate of Rs.311/- (Rupees Three Hundred Eleven only) per person per day, subject to actual deployment and attendance duly verified b y the authorized municipal officer. No payment shall be admissible for any person or working day durin g which the manpower has not actually been deployed. 13. The agency shall ensure that the deployed manpower is physically fit for the assigned duties and is pro vided with necessary protective clothing, gloves, footwear and other safety equipment required for sno w-clearance operations. 14. The agency shall remain responsible for the proper conduct, discipline and safety of its deployed manp ower and operators/drivers. All personnel shall follow the instructions of the authorized municipal office r and comply with applicable safety requirements. 15. The agency shall be solely responsible for payment of wages/remuneration to the deployed manpower at the prescribed Government-approved rate of Rs.311/- per person per day and for compliance with ap plicable labour laws and statutory obligations. 16. The agency shall be responsible for any accident, injury, damage to public or private property or other liability arising out of negligence or improper operation of machinery or conduct of its deployed person nel during execution of the work. 17. Proper deployment records/logbooks shall be maintained by the agency indicating the date, location, machinery deployed, commencement and completion timings and actual working hours. Similarly, atte ndance records of manpower shall be maintained on a daily basis. All such records shall be verified an d certified by the designated municipal officer. 18. Payment for machinery shall be made strictly on the basis of actual working hours duly authorized, ver ified and certified by the competent/designated municipal officer at the accepted contractual rates. 19. Payment towards manpower shall be restricted to the actual number of persons deployed and working days duly verified and certified by the authorized municipal officer, at the Government-approved rate o f ₹311/- per person per day, subject to applicable statutory provisions and financial formalities. 20. No payment shall be admissible for idle hours, unauthorized deployment, unverified working hours, ab sentee manpower or any machinery/personnel not actually utilized for the assigned work. 21. The Municipal Committee shall not be liable to guarantee minimum working hours, daily deployment, c ontinuous engagement or minimum payment to the successful bidder. The agency shall not be entitled to claim any compensation on account of non-deployment or lesser deployment due to insufficient sno wfall, change in weather conditions or any other operational requirement. 22. Failure to provide the required machinery or manpower within the stipulated time, repeated breakdow ns, unauthorized withdrawal of machinery/personnel, absenteeism or unsatisfactory performance shall render the agency liable to proportionate deductions, penalties or other appropriate contractual action in accordance with the published GeM bid conditions and applicable rules. 23. The successful bidder shall not sublet or transfer the contract, wholly or partly, to any other agency/pe rson without prior written approval of the competent authority. 24. The Municipal Committee reserves the right to terminate the contract in case of persistent non-perfor mance, violation of contractual conditions or any other valid reason, in accordance with applicable rule s and contractual provisions. 3. Financial Bid / Rate Quotation The bidders shall quote separate rates for each category of machinery in the prescribed GeM financial bid, as per the following units: S. No. Description Unit of Quotation 1. JCB Excavator/Backhoe Loader Per working hour 2. Tipper Per working hour, per vehicle 3. Tractor fitted with Snow Blade/Leveller Per working hour, per vehicle

4. Manpower for manual snow clearance and allied Per person per day (Governm field operations ent-approved rate: Rs. 311/-) The manpower shall be deployed strictly as per actual requirement, subject to a maximum of 15 persons, and payment shall be made only for actual working days duly verified and certified by the authorized officer. The rates quoted for machinery shall be inclusive of all applicable operational expenses, including POL, op erators/drivers, maintenance and repairs. No additional financial liability shall be created upon the Municip al Committee beyond the accepted contractual rates and admissible manpower payments. 4. Documents to be Submitted by the Bidder The bidder shall upload the following documents along with the bid, wherever applicable and as prescribed under GeM: 1. PAN Card of the bidder/firm. 2. GST Registration Certificate, wherever applicable. 3. Registration/constitution details of the firm or agency. 4. Details and ownership/valid possession documents of the machinery proposed to be deployed. 5. Undertaking confirming the availability of 02 JCBs, 02 Tippers and 02 Tractors throughout the contract p eriod. 6. Undertaking confirming the availability of up to 15 manpower personnel for manual snow clearance and allied field operations, as and when required. 7. Undertaking confirming payment of manpower wages at the Government-approved rate of ₹311/- per p erson per day. 8. Undertaking confirming that all machinery shall be maintained in good working condition and deployed immediately upon requisition. 9. Acceptance of all terms and conditions of the bid. 10. Any other document specifically required under the published GeM bid. 5. General Conditions The successful bidder shall execute the work strictly in accordance with the instructions of the Municipal C ommittee and the terms and conditions stipulated in the GeM bid. The Municipal Committee reserves the ri ght to regulate the deployment of machinery and manpower according to actual snowfall conditions, opera tional priorities and public safety requirements. The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids, wholly or partly, in accordan ce with applicable rules and GeM provisions, without assigning any reason thereof. .
